name: chimera-kit
description: The JavaScript toolkit for Chimera: physical voice synthesis, singing, live articulation, beatbox and creatures in the browser.

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build -p intone-chimera -p intone-creatures --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && mkdir -p dist && wasm-opt -O3 --enable-bulk-memory --enable-mutable-globals --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int --enable-sign-ext --enable-reference-types --enable-multivalue target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/intone_chimera.wasm -o dist/chimera.wasm && wasm-opt -O3 --enable-bulk-memory --enable-mutable-globals --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int --enable-sign-ext --enable-reference-types --enable-multivalue target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/intone_creatures.wasm -o dist/creatures.wasm
scripts.build:js: bun scripts/clean-dist.ts && bun build src/index.ts src/worker.ts src/live.ts src/creatures.ts src/imitate.ts src/tools.ts src/singing.ts src/performance.ts src/performance-pool.ts src/performance-worker.ts src/ensemble.ts src/sequence.ts --root src --outdir dist --format esm --target browser --minify --splitting && bun build src/worklet-live.ts --root src --outdir dist --format esm --target browser --minify && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:js && cp public/data/cmudict.txt.gz dist/
scripts.test: bun run build && cargo test --workspace && bun test --timeout 30000 src eval
scripts.lint: biome check . && cargo fmt -p intone-chimera -p intone-creatures --check && cargo clippy -p intone-chimera -p intone-creatures --no-deps --all-targets -- -D warnings
